$comment: The closed list of what an AI generator may set. GENERATED from the section contracts (2.0.0: 94 sections) and re-derived from schema/pagespec.schema.json by extraction/verify_all.py::check_allowlist_schema, which compares EVERY settable path (not just top-level keys). Anything absent is not settable.
globalRules: 33 templates cover the 58 real routes (templates/templates.json). Do not invent templates or routes; a route outside a template's measured routes is allowed but flagged.
Set only the paths listed under settableProperties. Everything else (layout, tokens, button variants, breakpoints) is contract-owned.
Every text field respects maxWords. Write ORIGINAL placeholder copy -- never the original site's text, brand ('Thrive'), assistant ('Kiki') or real third-party names.
Every media field is {assetRole, ...} with a role from the field's own list. For any role that is not may-generate-new, render the neutral placeholder: no assetRef, no file path, no URL.
Never reference the source project's public/assets/ files -- they are the user's local reference copies of a real company's imagery.
Every form stays a static placeholder (form.live:false, no endpoint); every video stays a static placeholder.
motion.pattern from the section's allowedMotionPatterns; reducedMotionFallback equal to the section's const.
There is NO per-instance style/token-override field. Styling is owned by the contracts; this is stated so nobody looks for a mechanism that was never built.
Fill each slot with a variant listed in that template slot's `variants`; a CHOICE slot takes exactly one of the slot or its alternatives.
stock.photo (may-reuse-licensed) may reference public/stock files as assetRef 'stock/<id>.jpg' -- and only on fields that list stock.photo.

tokenOverridePolicy.note: No PageSpec field exists for token overrides; nothing to validate at the PageSpec layer.
